implementation: README, installation, Tailscale, operations, troubleshooting, protocol, contribution, changelog, and trademark notice documentation describe the implemented narrow remote facade, explicit /dispatch flow, loopback-only topology, revocation, recovery, data deletion, and support boundaries.

Security and threat-model documentation now identify the repository-owned GitHub private advisory channel, an unconfigured owner-domain email placeholder, supply-chain controls, and the absence of absolute-security or first-party affiliation claims.

PR-safe CI uses read-only permissions; CodeQL and dependency review use verified immutable action commits; secret scanning checks committed source, reachable history, and the exact deterministic package artifact.

The trusted release workflow only runs for protected v* tags, requires the protected npm environment, verifies tag and package versions, builds and inspects the package, creates an SPDX SBOM and SHA-256 digest, attests the artifacts, and publishes the exact tarball through npm OIDC provenance. It has no pull-request, branch, manual-dispatch, token, or credential publishing path.
